title: 📝 Vocabulary Mini-Test

sections.heading: Instructions
sections.body:
This mini-test covers all vocabulary from this unit. You need 70% or above to unlock the next unit.

Each question is worth equal marks. Read every option carefully before answering.

highlight: If you're unsure, eliminate the obviously wrong options first — this improves your chances significantly.

question: "The drought _______ existing water shortages." Which word correctly completes the sentence?
explanation:
"Exacerbated" = made worse. A drought makes water shortages worse.

"Mitigated" = reduced/lessened — opposite meaning
"Substantiated" = provided evidence for — doesn't fit here
"Proliferated" = increased rapidly in number — doesn't collocate with drought

question: "Smartphones have become _______ in modern society." Which word fits?
explanation:
"Ubiquitous" (adjective) = found everywhere — perfect for describing how common smartphones are.

The other words are VERBS — they don't fit the adjective slot after "become".

sentence: The study _______ that diet has a significant effect on mental health outcomes.
explanation:
"Demonstrated" is the formal academic reporting verb.

Reporting verbs hierarchy:
suggest (weak) → indicate → demonstrate → prove (strong)

Never "told" or "talked about" for research findings.

question: Which sentence uses the most sophisticated vocabulary?
options: The use of technology has increased a lot.
The proliferation of digital technology has fundamentally altered patterns of human communication.
Technology has become very common and it has changed how people talk.
correct: The proliferation of digital technology has fundamentally altered patterns of human communication.
explanation:
✅ Band 8+ features:
• "proliferation" — sophisticated noun (not "increase" or "spread")
• "fundamentally altered" — precise verb phrase
• "patterns of human communication" — academic noun phrase
• No vague words: no "very", "a lot", "everywhere"

sentences.text: Urban development has exacerbated traffic congestion in major cities.
The research substantiates the problem of climate change.
sentences.explanation:
"Substantiate" means to PROVE or PROVIDE EVIDENCE for something — you don't substantiate a problem.

✅ Correct options:
• "The research substantiates the link between emissions and climate change"
• "Urban development has exacerbated the problem of climate change"

sentences.text: The proliferation of social media platforms has transformed communication.
